title: Philosophia theologiae ancillans (Exercitatio Prima Art. I-II tip)
author: Robert Baron
edition: Philosophia theologiae ancillans (Oxford: T. Robinson & R. Davis, 1658; Editi priori correctior). Wing B887. IA bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_philosophia-theologi-an_baron-robert_1658. Tip: Exercitatio Prima Art. I-II De Ente & Essentia. First edition Andreapoli 1621 (Rabanus).
blurb: Robert Baron — opening of the First Exercise On Being and Essence from the 1658 Oxford Latin of Philosophia theologiae ancillans. Tip covers Art. I (necessary being) and Art. II (being by essence) only; the rest of the work remains.
era_note: Baron wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed philosophy professor at St Salvator's College, St Andrews. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1658 Oxford Latin is public domain. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1658 Oxford Latin of Exercitatio Prima Art. I-II, reconstructed from IA PDF page images (leaves ~15-18) with DjVu OCR as check. No modern English was copied. First edition is St Andrews 1621; tip copy-text is the 1658 corrected reprint.
